covered_agreements.note: The title-cell reader cannot see this table's row boundaries: its cells hold more than one printed number, or a printed number opens no cell. This reading groups the table's lines into blocks separated by ragged (short) lines and keys each block by the number printed inside it, so every printed number opens its own row. A run of lines printed above a number is absorbed as that row's own prefix within `row_attach_pt` of the number it opens, which is this reader's own reach and the tolerance its rows were decided with, and `row_attach_band_pt` is the interval this table's own printed runs leave that reach: the declared value lies in it, a run printed at its lower edge is absorbed up and one printed at its upper edge would be, and a reading that leaves one side of that decision empty carries an empty interval. This reading was accepted only because it accounts for every number the table prints.
